dog.description_text:
Meet Mama Rosa

Mama Rosa’s journey is one of incredible strength, devotion, and second chances.

She was rescued from Devore Shelter in California, where she not only faced an uncertain future—but also rose to the challenge of motherhood. Mama Rosa did an amazing job nursing and caring for her nine babies, keeping them safe, healthy, and thriving until rescue stepped in. Thanks to her dedication, every one of her puppies got the chance they deserved.

After being transported across the country to Brixies Rescue Inc., Mama Rosa has continued to show just how special she is.

Since arriving in rescue, she has made remarkable progress. She’s learned basic cues like “sit,” is actively working on disengaging when she notices strangers, and has shown herself to be very food motivated, making training and confidence-building both effective and rewarding.

Mama Rosa does well with children (with supervision) and is thoughtful and observant in the home. She is still working through slow, structured introductions with resident dogs, and we are committed to honoring her pace so she can feel secure and successful.

What Mama Rosa Needs

Mama Rosa is looking for an experienced, breed-knowledgeable foster or adopter, or a home with someone willing to learn and actively work with trainers. She will thrive with structure, consistency, positive reinforcement, and continued guidance as she transitions into a new environment.

She has already given so much of herself—now it’s her turn to be someone’s priority.
